data.name: Ammarina
data.gender_notes: Ammarina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ammarina is derived from the name Ammar, which means 'supporter'. The feminine form, Ammarina, can be interpreted as a devout, supporting woman. The name Ammarina carries the meaning “Supporting, devout woman” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ammarina usually hope their child will grow to embody supporting, devout woman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a strong and supportive person, who is always there for others in times of need
data.etymology: Ammarina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporting, devout woman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ammarina total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أمّارينا
in_arabic.meaning: أمّارينا تعني الشخصية القوية والمؤثرة في المجتمع
in_arabic.long_meaning: أمّارينا هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من اسم 'أمّار' الذي يعني الشخص الذي يترك أثرًا كبيرًا في نفوس الناس. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة والقيادة والإلهام. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر اسم 'أمّار' في سياق الحديث عن الأشخاص الذين يتصفون بالصبر والثبات على الحق.

in_urdu.name: امارینا
in_urdu.meaning: امارینا کا مطلب ہے مضبوط اور بااثر شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: امارینا ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی मूल سے ہے. اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو لوگوں کے دل و دماغ پر گہرا اثر ڈالتا ہے. یہ نام قوت, قیادت اور الہام کے معانیを持つ کرتا ہے. عربی زبان میں 'أمّار' کی اصطلاح ان لوگوں کے لئے استعمال ہوتی ہے جو صبر اور استقامت کی تعریف کرتے ہیں.

in_hindi.name: अम्मारिना
in_hindi.meaning: अम्मारिना का अर्थ है मजबूत और प्रभावशाली व्यक्तित्व
in_hindi.long_meaning: अम्मारिना एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी मूल से है. इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो लोगों के हृदय और मस्तिष्क पर गहरा प्रभाव डालता है. यह नाम शक्ति, नेतृत्व और प्रेरणा के अर्थों को धारण करता है. अरबी भाषा में 'أمّار' की पदावली उन लोगों के लिए प्रयोग होती है जो धैर्य और दृढ़ता की परिभाषा करते हैं.

in_pashto.name: امارینه
in_pashto.meaning: امارینه د قوي او موثر شخصیت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: امارینه يو مونث نوم دى چه د عربي اصلي څخه يې اخيستل شوی دی. دا پدې معنی دی چه هغه څوک چي د خلکو په زړونو او دماغو کي ژور اغیز کوي. دا نوم د قوت، مشرت او الهام د معانيو څښتن دی. په عربي ژبه کي 'أمّار' هغه کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چي د صبر او ثابت قدمۍ تعريف کوي.

in_english.name: Ammarina
in_english.meaning: Ammarina means strong and influential personality
in_english.long_meaning: Ammarina is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It refers to a person who leaves a profound impact on people's hearts and minds. The name embodies the meanings of strength, leadership, and inspiration. Etymologically derived from the Arabic root 'أمّار', it relates to individuals characterized by patience and steadfastness. This name holds significant cultural and spiritual value in Islamic tradition, symbolizing positive influence and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ammarina holds a rich cultural heritage in Islamic and Arabic societies. It signifies a woman who stands by her loved ones' side through thick and thin. Historically, there have been many notable women named Ammarina who have inspired generations with their unwavering loyalty and courage in the face of adversity. For instance, during the early Islamic period, Asma bint Amr, a noblewoman known as Ammara, emerged as a powerful figure, known for her strong-willed personality and her dedication to the Muslim community.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, Ammarina embodies the spirit of selflessness and devotion to one's faith and loved ones. In the Islamic tradition, supporting and safeguarding fellow believers is crucial to the wider community's well-being and unity. The name Ammarina serves as a reminder that strength and resilience are essential qualities for any woman who aspires to contribute positively to her family, community, and ultimately, to society. Simultaneously, it is a reminder to remain steadfast in one's faith and support the faith and spiritual growth of others.
